messages:
Priya (Support): FYI, Acme reported intermittent 504s + 5xx when calling /v1/generate over the last ~2 hours. Their app experienced long retry loops in the JS SDK and some calls never surfaced a final error. Repro steps and logs below.

Diego (SRE): :eyes: do we have an example request_id / correlation id to trace?

Priya (Support): Yep — request_id=rc_20260315_0453_7a9b2c, approx timestamps 2026-03-15T04:53Z. Gateway logs show upstream read timeout and repeated 504s for that id.

Alex (Eng): Can you paste the exact curl + SDK snippet they ran so we can reproduce locally?

Priya (Support): Here's the curl they used:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-realtime","input":"hello","stream":false}' 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
And their Node snippet (JS SDK 0.12.1):
```
await client.responses.create({
  model: 'gpt-4o-realtime',
  input: 'hello',
  timeout: 5000
})
```
They reported default timeout was 5s and a lot of retries kicked in.

Maya (Platform): Any deploys or infra events around 04:40-05:10Z? deploy-bot should show that window.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for runtime-service@v2.14.3 by @alex - status: complete :white_check_mark:

Diego (SRE): I pulled the gateway/nginx logs for rc_20260315_0453_7a9b2c — upstream response 504, nginx error "upstream prematurely closed connection"; upstream_addr=10.4.12.7:8080. TLS resets seen from that backend too.

Priya (Support): Customer also called out a separate symptom: occasional 401s followed by retries which then hit timeouts. They suspect auth header truncation in some mobile envs but the 504s are happening server-side too.

billing-bot: Alert: multiple low-value charges detected for acct acct_9876 during window 04:40-05:10Z. See billing dashboard: https://internal.redwood/billing/acct_9876

Alex (Eng): Hypotheses: (a) backend pod saturation / OOM leading to stalled responses, (b) connection pool exhaustion at the runtime or envoy level, (c) a KV cache compaction/GC spike causing CPU stalls. Diego, can you check pod events / kube metrics?

Diego (SRE): K8s events show several OOMKilled on runtime-pool-7 at ~04:49Z. HPA scaled from 3 -> 5 at 04:50Z. Metrics: CPU and RSS spiked on those nodes; envoy upstream queue length spiked concurrently.

Maya (Platform): That maps to a known issue: certain KV cache compaction runs in 2.14.3 can produce long GC pauses under sustained concurrency. We shipped a mitigation in 2.14.4. Looks like a subset of nodes still running 2.14.3.

Alex (Eng): Ok — immediate mitigations: (1) restart affected pods to clear compaction state; (2) pin high-traffic customer to a healthier pool; (3) roll runtime to 2.14.4 cluster-wide. Priya, can we ask customer to increase client timeout as a stopgap?

Priya (Support): Reached out to the customer with suggested mitigations: set SDK timeout to 15s, add exponential backoff (base 200ms, cap 5s), and we offered to route them to a different pool while we fix infra. Waiting on confirm.

Diego (SRE): Restarted runtime-pool-7 pods at 05:05Z (cordon -> drain -> restart); post-restart telemetry shows CPU returning to normal and tail latency improved. No new 504s for requests after 05:06Z for the traced correlation ids.

Priya (Support): Customer confirmed they applied the SDK timeout change and saw immediate improvement. They still saw 502/504 spikes during the restart window but overall success rate improved.

Maya (Platform): I'll schedule a prioritized rollout to move all remaining nodes to 2.14.4 within the next 2 hours and add a tighter preflight for KV compaction thresholds.

Alex (Eng): For follow-ups: (a) patch JS SDK default timeout/backoff (increase default timeout to 10s + smarter retry jitter) in next minor; (b) add an internal doc for recommended SDK client settings for high-latency tails; (c) billing review for credits.

billing-bot: Billing case created: CASE-20260315-332 for acct_9876

Diego (SRE): I also added a temporary alert rule to detect KV compaction CPU spikes and to scale earlier (thresholds lowered). Monitoring dashboard: https://internal.redwood/monitoring/runtime/kv_compaction

Priya (Support): Customer updated and billing engaged. I'm going to close this thread once billing confirms credits and platform finishes the rollout. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround :heart:
